For my priyotoma 💗

Meghaaaaa, amar priyotoma… 🥹❤️ Khub miss korchi tomay ami Kolkatay. Ami prottek din opekkha kori, ar din guni—jobe tumi firbe. Kichu kichu somoy ache, jegulo mone porlei mon ta abar tomar kache chole jay. Mone ache amader sei 15th February? Ganga-r dhare tumi ar ami pasapashi boshe chilam… ki romantic chilo seidin, bolo? Ichhe kore abar oi somoy-ta fire pai—tomar pashe boshe thaki, tomar haat-ta dhore rakhi, ar kono tarahuro chara sudhu tomake niye thaki. Distance-ta ekhon koshto dey, kintu amar moner moddhe amader oi chhoto chhoto moment-gulo roj alo jaliye rakhe. Ami opekkhay roilam, amar priyotoma. Amra abar orom ekta romantic somoy katabo—aro golpo, aro hasi, aro hug, aar onek bhalobasha niye. 🥰🥰🫂🫂 Joto din-i laguk, tomar sathe dekha howar oi moment-ta amar kache special thakbe. Tomar, Ayan ❤️
Always yours, Ayan ♡
If I could teleport anywhere right now, Meghaaaa, I’d choose the place beside you. Until then, please keep one extra hug saved for me. I’m coming to collect it. 🥹💗🫂
